## Description

Briefly describe the change and the motivation behind it.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] Watchlist or metadata update (`data/library.json`)
- [ ] Frontend enhancement (`index.html`, `script.js`, `style.css`)
- [ ] Backend or scraper update (`server.py`, `scripts/`)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Validation

- [ ] Python syntax validation passed (`make lint`)
- [ ] Full unit test suite passed (`make test`)
- [ ] README regeneration verified (`make update-readme`)
- [ ] DOM rendering tested in browser with no console errors

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's zero-build philosophy
- [ ] All dynamic DOM insertions pass through `escapeHtml()`
- [ ] No API keys are hardcoded or committed
